description: Full-text search over the encoded tax-law corpus ('kiddie tax', 'NIIT threshold', 'california renters credit'). Returns matching rules: id, title, statutory citation, effective window, and a verbatim excerpt of the law text. A hit means the engine computes this; zero hits means it is outside the corpus — say so rather than guessing. Follow up with explain_rule for a hit's full formula, or lookup_tax_parameter for its dollar amounts.
name: search_tax_rules
